exam.title: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is published. Salesforce describes a candidate with about one year configuring the platform and standard objects, including Data 360, plus hands-on Agent Builder, Prompt Builder, Testing Center and sandbox-to-production experience. Practice the complete governed lifecycle with synthetic data: prompts, retrieval, agents and actions, evaluation, promotion, observability and secured multi-agent interoperability.

review.notes: All six Spring '26 domains are mapped through governed prompt/template and Data 360 retrieval lifecycles, agent/subagent and deterministic action design, representative Testing Center evaluation, dependency-aware deployment, correlated governance/observability, and secured SOMA/MCP/A2A boundaries. Three scenarios, eight authorized labs and 40 original checks are included. Complete indexed official text confirms the candidate boundary, contract, six weights and objective snapshot despite the simple-HTML wrapper. Salesforce Well-Architected security guidance adds agent-identity and action-context practice without becoming exam scope. No recalled/live item, dump, shared superbadge solution or copied course content is used.

public_objective_groups.title: Prompt Engineering
objectives: Given business requirements, identify when it's appropriate to use Prompt Builder.
Identify access controls governing prompt templates.
Identify the considerations for using a prompt template type such as field generation and flex types.
Given a scenario, identify the appropriate grounding technique.
Explain the process for creating, activating, and executing prompt templates.
Explain how to implement best practices for writing effective prompts.
Identify the security and privacy features of the Trust Layer.
Explain how to manage and prevent specific models from being accessed.

public_objective_groups.title: Data 360 Fundamentals
objectives: Explain the considerations of Agentforce Data Library and its concepts.
Explain foundational concepts of Data 360 such as chunking, indexing, and retrievers.

public_objective_groups.title: AI Agents
objectives: Explain how an agent works and its basic building blocks of agent script.
Explain the components and benefits of hybrid reasoning, including how Agent Script functions in Canvas and Script View.
Given a use case, manage deterministic behavior for the agent using mechanisms like filters, variables, and template expressions.
Given a scenario, select and configure standard topics, custom topics, standard Agent actions, and custom Agent actions.
Explain the process for connecting agents to various channels such as digital experience, email, voice, and Slack.
Explain the security context in which the agent is actually running, and how it impacts agent action execution.
Given a scenario, identify when to use an Employee or Service agent.
Given a scenario, identify when it's appropriate to use Agent API.

public_objective_groups.title: Testing, Deployment, and Maintenance
objectives: Given a scenario, test an agent using Testing Center.
Explain how Testing Center evaluations work.
Identify the considerations for deploying an agent from sandbox to production.
Identify the considerations for deploying a template from sandbox to production.

public_objective_groups.title: Governance and Observability
objectives: Explain the process for managing and monitoring agents.
Explain agent analytics and agent optimization.

public_objective_groups.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
objectives: Given a scenario, determine whether a Multi Agent architecture is appropriate for scalability and control.
Explain the purpose of existing open standard multi-agent protocols such as MCP and A2A.
